### Key Risks

- **Increased drowsiness and sedation:** Both substances can calm the nervous system and affect GABA pathways, which may intensify sleepiness, dizziness, and sluggishness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXWHrepKbB17dFaBQu8TnSxYFbflxs-PnEMdO9Wkw88e5ZooHPRJRi3lCj_I4eIiRjgFu9UfZIi66ePCPv9VN-YZp_Ol3KSnWWRWHJvQr37NKQrYoX2X13koz8Q2j0Z9UdMHjpk2BBye1nTqdG)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF1xk_7Bts4JreRmNbRUu04PEO3TjkjIpClp8oLv8794B6QfdfjvfqqR4GTeLJSVrEcpVfnJzrtyjeeq2sVrxJ0Lto9kcI2RO7FGVGpw2YICShO2d0mqXN3rjt0E85rQmGa3OrVvvRvILlcpeGEIFBkE_hzVUXFlZbOayE3A)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXlhqXAdqUQXw6LdeaHY64qYPJoKOVjMXbMbljSu_WRyac21Ac-NqD4zbz17ZfcO4p8Rp4KaBXMFAhqpW3jdVlDjBlIRf8zpusIWve1Bzr3EAzD1CnIB0zTBEFKI_jmmfCgyItlYZiFIA)
- **Impaired coordination and reaction time:** Combining them can worsen motor coordination, alertness, and cognitive focus, raising accident risks.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXWHrepKbB17dFaBQu8TnSxYFbflxs-PnEMdO9Wkw88e5ZooHPRJRi3lCj_I4eIiRjgFu9UfZIi66ePCPv9VN-YZp_Ol3KSnWWRWHJvQr37NKQrYoX2X13koz8Q2j0Z9UdMHjpk2BBye1nTqdG)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF11wNtAoKEYZu5aa21fkQ8XJHiKANbxvQQVYWr_otR1MzpZthfMZRBSdkX5QgCxO5Lgv8GCYPTP2BNlknEuWVBrZ83y8VQ-7UFGS40UQcptswM3FG2V2wc5N1M7kQkZqd_JNibH_e_Wnc98z7eqHJGgdLMBMwio3JvOOLaCZ38vwwM3ABDF5uTqJHPaVw4ept5A)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF1xk_7Bts4JreRmNbRUu04PEO3TjkjIpClp8oLv8794B6QfdfjvfqqR4GTeLJSVrEcpVfnJzrtyjeeq2sVrxJ0Lto9kcI2RO7FGVGpw2YICShO2d0mqXN3rjt0E85rQmGa3OrVvvRvILlcpeGEIFBkE_hzVUXFlZbOayE3A)
- **Potential liver stress:** Rare cases of liver injury have been linked to ashwagandha products, and alcohol also places stress on the liver. Using both together may increase risk, especially with frequent drinking or pre-existing liver issues.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF1wfTbCNuoHABoTi7hnwmDkvM_0Mi-VBwDe9pV6yfjeQyjz9K5jYE1IGTtikywPVg68dJ-718-nUkLtf2napJ3J_7yjYm0qN5So920NKwKdFMbJ7uyOryOBf6jbvnhpYW7scGtfbG4xRWxmcmYlOlqUqigP9Bzer0lfeg7MZ-NPc7KHhBKSSq)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXWHrepKbB17dFaBQu8TnSxYFbflxs-PnEMdO9Wkw88e5ZooHPRJRi3lCj_I4eIiRjgFu9UfZIi66ePCPv9VN-YZp_Ol3KSnWWRWHJvQr37NKQrYoX2X13koz8Q2j0Z9UdMHjpk2BBye1nTqdG)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXWbFux3psvpkw5IA-oImDezMw2xCV_x4J9Y2_02ZNoqHbx9QdAl-SeKxn68h0FGVnikQ8JQEhfEcj-WvTI52bGtq5DxyebX4wMFukvOokNCneSKw0BWTPeVtbon883adg_qUboMIjOsHqriQP7w)
- **Medication interactions:** Risks can rise if you take sedatives, anti-anxiety drugs, sleep aids, or thyroid medications.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXy-djyhznutXYokbfvpEacJLdIpNKuNXk9jfMoHaBZHGqIIXuej_YDWUk5h0e3aYDNS5HO743PQtqK8RkBwm8CaLlOY1Jn1VoZxpQmNE93h1y-3Kkdtadp8qnLNdXLmB49Y7F0A3ANzC1wdKg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXWHrepKbB17dFaBQu8TnSxYFbflxs-PnEMdO9Wkw88e5ZooHPRJRi3lCj_I4eIiRjgFu9UfZIi66ePCPv9VN-YZp_Ol3KSnWWRWHJvQr37NKQrYoX2X13koz8Q2j0Z9UdMHjpk2BBye1nTqdG)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF1wfTbCNuoHABoTi7hnwmDkvM_0Mi-VBwDe9pV6yfjeQyjz9K5jYE1IGTtikywPVg68dJ-718-nUkLtf2napJ3J_7yjYm0qN5So920NKwKdFMbJ7uyOryOBf6jbvnhpYW7scGtfbG4xRWxmcmYlOlqUqigP9Bzer0lfeg7MZ-NPc7KHhBKSSq)

### Practical Precautions

- **Avoid mixing them when possible:** Skip ashwagandha on days you plan to drink, or avoid alcohol while supplementing.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXWHrepKbB17dFaBQu8TnSxYFbflxs-PnEMdO9Wkw88e5ZooHPRJRi3lCj_I4eIiRjgFu9UfZIi66ePCPv9VN-YZp_Ol3KSnWWRWHJvQr37NKQrYoX2X13koz8Q2j0Z9UdMHjpk2BBye1nTqdG)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF17Q_8Gy3_OpAjuIeRKa7G9RAWH5P8IZe1nTjllIGh-VfjN1z0cj_oLNhmT9b7MVCZOUKKkOM6OMOKVigaq65AxTMoMvWjn7F6LCHdM-OcKY6Llz6DspqjgBApzBpnDV6Sz8z2cyKopWSmq0QV8a1VthvWyYa8s7pflYm9RoaeQpherglMA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXGCvyUsXw1GKQVHjzSsqSXqawma9GhFY3mWqmZcmC2x3MAxXC-aKIwpPNknkzVEyLbryGKxwRpQg0A6RarrRlHsCLciEXT_NHQKbwRLtZJkymM9jdkHhQAXv4gQrxH8KUnKCmcw3aGLl1qFefE2FfnA)
- **Watch for warning signs:** Seek medical care if you notice severe drowsiness, confusion, breathing trouble, or signs of liver distress such as yellowing skin or eyes, dark urine, severe abdominal pain, or persistent nausea.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXWbFux3psvpkw5IA-oImDezMw2xCV_x4J9Y2_02ZNoqHbx9QdAl-SeKxn68h0FGVnikQ8JQEhfEcj-WvTI52bGtq5DxyebX4wMFukvOokNCneSKw0BWTPeVtbon883adg_qUboMIjOsHqriQP7w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF11wNtAoKEYZu5aa21fkQ8XJHiKANbxvQQVYWr_otR1MzpZthfMZRBSdkX5QgCxO5Lgv8GCYPTP2BNlknEuWVBrZ83y8VQ-7UFGS40UQcptswM3FG2V2wc5N1M7kQkZqd_JNibH_e_Wnc98z7eqHJGgdLMBMwio3JvOOLaCZ38vwwM3ABDF5uTqJHPaVw4ept5A)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF17Q_8Gy3_OpAjuIeRKa7G9RAWH5P8IZe1nTjllIGh-VfjN1z0cj_oLNhmT9b7MVCZOUKKkOM6OMOKVigaq65AxTMoMvWjn7F6LCHdM-OcKY6Llz6DspqjgBApzBpnDV6Sz8z2cyKopWSmq0QV8a1VthvWyYa8s7pflYm9RoaeQpherglMA)
- **Check with a doctor:** Ask a healthcare provider before combining them, especially if you drink regularly, have liver concerns, or take daily medications. You can also review general interaction guidance on [Drugs.com](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXWbFux3psvpkw5IA-oImDezMw2xCV_x4J9Y2_02ZNoqHbx9QdAl-SeKxn68h0FGVnikQ8JQEhfEcj-WvTI52bGtq5DxyebX4wMFukvOokNCneSKw0BWTPeVtbon883adg_qUboMIjOsHqriQP7w) or check potential symptoms using [Ubie Doctor's Note](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF11wNtAoKEYZu5aa21fkQ8XJHiKANbxvQQVYWr_otR1MzpZthfMZRBSdkX5QgCxO5Lgv8GCYPTP2BNlknEuWVBrZ83y8VQ-7UFGS40UQcptswM3FG2V2wc5N1M7kQkZqd_JNibH_e_Wnc98z7eqHJGgdLMBMwio3JvOOLaCZ38vwwM3ABDF5uTqJHPaVw4ept5A).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXWHrepKbB17dFaBQu8TnSxYFbflxs-PnEMdO9Wkw88e5ZooHPRJRi3lCj_I4eIiRjgFu9UfZIi66ePCPv9VN-YZp_Ol3KSnWWRWHJvQr37NKQrYoX2X13koz8Q2j0Z9UdMHjpk2BBye1nTqdG)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXWbFux3psvpkw5IA-oImDezMw2xCV_x4J9Y2_02ZNoqHbx9QdAl-SeKxn68h0FGVnikQ8JQEhfEcj-WvTI52bGtq5DxyebX4wMFukvOokNCneSKw0BWTPeVtbon883adg_qUboMIjOsHqriQP7w)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF11wNtAoKEYZu5aa21fkQ8XJHiKANbxvQQVYWr_otR1MzpZthfMZRBSdkX5QgCxO5Lgv8GCYPTP2BNlknEuWVBrZ83y8VQ-7UFGS40UQcptswM3FG2V2wc5N1M7kQkZqd_JNibH_e_Wnc98z7eqHJGgdLMBMwio3JvOOLaCZ38vwwM3ABDF5uTqJHPaVw4ept5A)

Potential liver stress: Rare cases of liver injury have been linked to ashwagandha products, and alcohol also places stress on the liver. Using both together may increase risk, especially with frequent drinking or pre-existing liver issues. Medication interactions: Risks can rise if you take sedatives, anti-anxiety drugs, sleep aids, or thyroid medications.

- **Watch for warning signs:** Seek medical care if you notice severe drowsiness, confusion, breathing trouble, or signs of liver distress such as yellowing skin or eyes, dark urine, severe abdominal pain, or persistent nausea.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXWbFux3psvpkw5IA-oImDezMw2xCV_x4J9Y2_02ZNoqHbx9QdAl-SeKxn68h0FGVnikQ8JQEhfEcj-WvTI52bGtq5DxyebX4wMFukvOokNCneSKw0BWTPeVtbon883adg_qUboMIjOsHqriQP7w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF11wNtAoKEYZu5aa21fkQ8XJHiKANbxvQQVYWr_otR1MzpZthfMZRBSdkX5QgCxO5Lgv8GCYPTP2BNlknEuWVBrZ83y8VQ-7UFGS40UQcptswM3FG2V2wc5N1M7kQkZqd_JNibH_e_Wnc98z7eqHJGgdLMBMwio3JvOOLaCZ38vwwM3ABDF5uTqJHPaVw4ept5A)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF17Q_8Gy3_OpAjuIeRKa7G9RAWH5P8IZe1nTjllIGh-VfjN1z0cj_oLNhmT9b7MVCZOUKKkOM6OMOKVigaq65AxTMoMvWjn7F6LCHdM-OcKY6Llz6DspqjgBApzBpnDV6Sz8z2cyKopWSmq0QV8a1VthvWyYa8s7pflYm9RoaeQpherglMA)
- **Check with a doctor:** Ask a healthcare provider before combining them, especially if you drink regularly, have liver concerns, or take daily medications.
